dimensions.name: contract
dimensions.question: Is the behavior represented by a stable typed contract?

dimensions.name: reference
dimensions.question: Does a deterministic reference implementation exist?

dimensions.name: conformance
dimensions.question: Does differential or standards conformance pass?

dimensions.name: cancellation
dimensions.question: Are cancellation and quiescence behavior qualified?

dimensions.name: crash_recovery
dimensions.question: Are kill points and recovery outcomes qualified?

dimensions.name: security
dimensions.question: Are authority, secrets, input bounds, and isolation qualified?

dimensions.name: privacy
dimensions.question: Are masks, retention, redaction, and deletion closure qualified?

dimensions.name: performance
dimensions.question: Are pinned same-workload performance artifacts retained?

dimensions.name: quality
dimensions.question: Are task-quality metrics and confidence intervals retained?

dimensions.name: compatibility
dimensions.question: Are exact device, firmware, model, and platform generations certified?

dimensions.name: operability
dimensions.question: Do doctor, support bundle, replay, and repair surfaces work?

dimensions.name: documentation
dimensions.question: Do docs, schemas, registries, and implementation agree?
